basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old crime show aficionado based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. I work as a logistics manager, balancing my time between work, family, and my passion for crime dramas. I enjoy exploring cultural nuances and local delicacies, which is why I frequent subreddits related to Malaysian culture and international cuisines. I'm married with two kids and typically online during late evenings after the kids are asleep. I also have a penchant for sharing and discovering new music, particularly jazz and indie rock.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in crime shows, particularly the CSI franchise, which I have followed since its inception. My background in logistics has made me detail-oriented, which translates into my analytical approach to solving mysteries in TV shows. I also have a broad understanding of Southeast Asian culture and current affairs, thanks to my active participation in related subreddits.
